verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's trust page commits to zero-data-retention agreements with all model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data. That is a default policy which keeps customer data out of AI model training, both by Lorikeet and by its upstream model providers. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the no-training policy (contract or DPA terms, scope), independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is enforced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Zero-data-retention agreements with all model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data.
